extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting unsolicited fiction or nonfiction to Timothy McSweeney’s Quarterly Concern
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for unsolicited submissions to Timothy McSweeney’s Quarterly Concern, covering what to send, how to format it, and editorial/payment/AI policies. Intended to help prospective contributors prepare and send work appropriate for the magazine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission address & response procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send unsolicited submissions to: McSweeney’s Quarterly c/o Rita Bullwinkel 849 Valencia St. San Francisco CA 94110.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you would like a response please include a self-addressed and pre-stamped postcard. We are unable to return manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style and subject
rubrics_metrics.description: We publish mostly fiction and some nonfiction. There are no rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The best way to get a sense of what we’re interested in publishing is to read the Quarterly (subscriptions/back issues available).

rubrics_metrics.name: Length
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no stated upper or lower length limit — send what you think belongs in the Quarterly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They like to hear from people who like the magazine. They are not concerned about writing degrees or past publications, so don’t be daunted if you don’t have an MFA or much in the way of previously published work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: It’s better if you don’t use colors or Fun Fonts or strange formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stick to simple, conventional formatting rather than decorative or unusual type/colors that might hinder reading or production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author bios
rubrics_metrics.description: Feel free to include a brief biography of yourself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short bio is optional and should be concise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously published work
rubrics_metrics.description: Previously published work will not be considered here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit only original, unpublished material to the Quarterly (previous publication disqualifies submissions for this venue).

rubrics_metrics.name: AI policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We accept no writing aided in any manner by AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before publishing any writing—from a letter to a book-length work—authors published at McSweeney’s will be asked to attest that AI played no part in the creation or writing of that work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment / contributor fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Contributors are paid at the time of publication, and our standard rate for short stories is $400.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fee for letters, flash fiction, translations, and other formats and situations varies according to circumstances, with equity in mind.

rubrics_metrics.name: Poetry policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry can be wonderful, but is not something we often publish in the Quarterly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poetry submissions are accepted in principle but are less frequently selected for publication than prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Website submissions separate
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions for the website should be sent to a different address, following different guidelines presented in a different link on this site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not send website-directed pieces to the Quarterly postal address; consult the separate guidelines/link for website submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial capacity & response time
rubrics_metrics.description: We gladly consider unsolicited works, but because we are a very small organization with an even smaller editorial department, it often takes us a long time to respond to our submitters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They appreciate patience as they work through submissions; expect delays and do not assume fast turnaround.
